title: Understanding MSE on Test Data
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, it can affect the model's complexity. Think about how this might influence the model's ability to generalize to new data.

title: Impact of Adding Features
text: Consider how adding a feature might affect the model's performance on unseen data. Could it lead to overfitting, underfitting, or neither?

title: Model Complexity and Generalization
text: Adding a feature increases the model's complexity. Reflect on how this complexity might impact the model's ability to generalize to new data. Does it always improve the model's performance?

title: Evaluating MSE Changes
text: Think about the relationship between model complexity and MSE on test data. What happens to MSE when a model becomes too complex?
